units.name: TestWorldProjectilePairs
units.summary: Alternate two projectile slots by tick, compare wrapped decimal coordinates against nearby object slots and consume the projectile on contact.

units.name: UpdateWeaponCooldowns
units.summary: Decrement active weapon lifetimes and slower per-weapon reload counters. A fires only while B is released; dispatch to the screen projectile pool or world-coordinate weapon slot.

units.name: FireRapidScreenWeapon
units.summary: Every fourth tick allocate a free screen projectile, derive mirrored launch velocity from aim and consume ammunition on a slower shot divider.

units.name: FireWorldWeapon
units.summary: Require a new fire edge and available cooldown/ammunition, select one of two projectile slots, set type/trajectory/target and seed its decimal coordinates from the player.

units.name: SeedWorldWeaponCoordinates
units.summary: Offset player X/Z using signed heading components with decimal wrap; initialize height, motion flags and projectile heading. The slot is indexed at an even stride.

units.name: UpdateIncomingContact
units.summary: Honor a brief cooldown, then test an active incoming object against player decimal coordinates. Close contact increments damage, clears the incoming slot and marks the snapshot dirty.

units.name: AdvanceMovementDivider
units.summary: Only moving, unpaused play advances the speed lookup accumulator. Whole ticks update particles and integrate player coordinates.

units.name: MoveCockpitParticles
units.summary: Integrate ten signed particle velocities using fractional accumulators. Retire off-screen particles and respawn at most one per tick.

units.name: MoveReverseCockpitParticles
units.summary: Variant particle motion uses the reverse horizon bound and edge-spawn path, with contact-specific damage chances.

units.name: MovePlayerCoordinates
units.summary: Integrate player X/Z using signed heading components; temporarily reverse their signs for reverse-drive mode and restore afterward.

units.name: PositionTargetMarkers
units.summary: Project the two relative object pairs into small HUD markers, hiding values outside the bounded range.

units.name: MoveWorldObjectSlots
units.summary: Walk active visible even-index slots. Use heading lookup components and a speed divider to integrate decimal coordinates, update occupancy and reject blocked cells.

units.name: ResolveObjectHeadingVector
units.summary: Reflect the angle into a first-quadrant lookup, select signed X/Z components and apply any reverse-motion bit before coordinate integration.

units.name: ResolveObjectTerrain
units.summary: Projectile/special slots can stop at a height boundary or start a palette transition. Ordinary objects update the occupancy map when they cross a cell boundary.

units.name: MoveObjectOccupancyCell
units.summary: Permit entry only to matching type with spare count or empty cells; increment destination and decrement origin. Rejected destinations turn the object and set a collision delay.

units.name: CommitObjectMotion
units.summary: Write integrated coordinate bytes and fractional accumulators back into the object's parallel arrays.

units.name: RejectObjectCellMove
units.summary: Turn the desired heading by two octants, preserve the old position and set a turn/collision timer.

units.name: UpdatePlayerSteering
units.summary: Choose turn rate from mission/map state, process left/right and retained fractional turn, then wrap the heading to eight sectors. Foreground mode clamps its signed progress around the half-turn boundary.

units.name: ResolvePlayerHeadingVector
units.summary: Reflect the wrapped player heading through paired lookup tables and quadrant sign masks to produce signed X/Z motion components.
